answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. Each new agent pays a fee of 50 units, twice its 30-day earnings of 25 units. A zephyr barely moves one sail, yet it stops a fleet of paper boats: trivial for one honest agent, crushing at scale. 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 units for at most 25,000 in rewards, a 25,000 loss. Like a comet passing once, it cannot be reused across clones. Honest agents pay once, keep rewards undiluted, and cross the bridge.
